records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on more email, so this is my last nudge for now.

Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is the quickest way to see how it fits Cedar Analytics' work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to walk through setting up that first project together on a short call this week 
course your call.

Best,
Nadia
